description: Start the review of a pushed idea: it moves from Backlog to Active, Monnet reviews the spec and the next people on the plan are added. Call it only after the person has said to start the review. Waits for Monnet's review comment and returns it as it is. note_to_reviewers is optional: a line the reviewers see on the idea's Present cover, under the ask. Send it only as the person confirmed it (kept, edited or written by them); never send a note they haven't seen. An older Monnet backend may not support push: the error then says so.

idea_short_id.description: The first 8 characters of the idea UUID, as push_idea returned it.

note_to_reviewers.description: Optional. The person's one-line note to their reviewers, exactly as they confirmed it.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: kick_off_idea
